source_fixture_directions.instructions: Do `recorded_directions` retain every explicit design instruction, preference, prohibition and open choice in `source.excerpt`?

criteria.true: Each explicit direction is recorded with the source's authority and scope. Descriptive business facts and feedback about a previous artifact are not new design instructions. A source without design directions needs none invented.
criteria.false: An explicit direction is missing, its authority is weakened, or its mandatory, preference, prohibition or open-choice scope is changed.
